digest.component_or_area: ADR 0098 - operation-scoped config and provider composition
propositions: Rebar must compose immutable non-secret operation configuration with separately owned provider-auth/runtime bindings at application boundaries
Operation snapshots are immutable and non-secret; live provider capabilities and provider-specific static carriers exist only in runtime bindings alongside the snapshot
Provider-native pre-client auth/session injection occurs at Rebar-owned factories with upstream/caller-owned credential lifecycle, not Rebar runtime management

Op-cert startup composition requires exactly one static key path or multiline value, validated once before service work, copied to process-owned 0700/0600 file, with no application runtime SSM/boto3/region coupling
ADR 0049 is amended only at per-job retrieval and global composition; its protocol, trust roots, producer, and persistence choices remain authoritative
Static restart/redeploy rotation and SDK-native in-process refresh remain distinct mechanisms; hot rotation is not owned by Rebar
